title: The Dutch-translated Climate and Health Tool for nurses: cross-cultural adaptation and validation
descriptions: The Dutch version of the Climate and Health Tool is a validated Dutch instrument to assess nurses’ awareness, concern, motivation and behavior on climate related health challenges—supporting stronger climate ready health systems. (SRDC)
